_s215e_steering_basis: 1.21.4's ItemBasedSteering kept the entity's saddle in a synched Boolean the mod passed in (constructor (entityData, boostTime, hasSaddle), setSaddle / hasSaddle / addAdditionalSaveData / readAdditionalSaveData); 1.21.5 dropped that accessor with the saddle's move to the SADDLE equipment slot, every kept member has the same body (javap -c -p both class_4980). A converted mod's steering is facade/ItemBasedSteering, a 1.21.5 ItemBasedSteering keeping the saddle in the mod's accessor as 1.21.4 did: NEW sites build it (ctorRedirects), a converted subclass extends it (superRenames), the saddle members' calls reach it (rt/CbSteering). The class itself is not renamed: a mod's mixin on 1.21.5's ItemBasedSteering still targets vanilla's.
